sentences.en: In short, there is a difference between guests and travellers.
sentences.zh: 简而言之，客人和旅行者之间存在差异。

sentences.en: Travellers on long-distance flights can suffer from deep vein thrombosis.
sentences.zh: 长途飞行的旅客可能会遭受深静脉血栓症。

sentences.en: The railway station was bustling with travellers saddled with Christmas presents.
sentences.zh: 火车站挤满了提着圣诞礼物的旅客。

senses.zh: 旅行者;旅游者;旅客;游客 - (尤指结队而行的)漂泊者;(常指)吉卜赛人
